why: The fleet state that PR #618's three controls were measured against.
Pinned here because #618's PR body recorded 'all three controls OK' with
no record of the input, and the same probe blob printed PROBE FAILED (1)
earlier the same day. A41 exists because of that pair of readings.
Every ref is refs/pull/<N>/head, which GitHub keeps after the branch is
deleted -- all seven of these branches were deleted when Jeff merged them
on 2026-10-01, and refs/heads/tide/win/** would no longer resolve.

main.note: main's tip when the 2026-10-01 windows cell ran both probes
